answer_1.quote: In this paper, we systematically evaluate LLMs' capability on the character profiling task, i.e., summarizing profiles for characters from fictional works.

answer_2.quote: We define Acc as the accuracy across the entire question dataset. ... We introduce Consistency Score ... evaluated by Llama-3-70B.

answer_3.quote: Specifically, we introduce Consistency Score, which is the degree of factual consistency between the reference profiles and the summaries generated by LLMs, evaluated by Llama-3-70B.

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the quality of the LLM evaluation, we randomly select 50 samples for human evaluation. We calculate the Pearson Correlation Coefficient between the consistency score result of human annotators and Llama-3-70B.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators assigned a score from 1 to 5 reflecting the factual consistency of the generated profile with the reference.
